> [!CAUTION] > **Beware of impostor sites.** MemPalace has no other official websites. The **only** official sources are this **[GitHub repository](https://github.com/MemPalace/mempalace)**, the **[PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/mempalace/)**, and the docs at **[mempalaceofficial.com](https://mempalaceofficial.com)**. Any other domain (including `.tech`, `.net`, or other `.com` variants) is an impostor and may distribute malware. Details and timeline: [docs/HISTORY.md](docs/HISTORY.md).
